messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up 9: we're planning a small API change: policy proxy will start emitting `x-route-hints-compact` in addition to existing headers. Goal: reduce header count and improve routing fidelity. Need SDK changes + console backfill plan.
ryan: Is this opt-in? breaking?
maya: It's opt-in from the SDK side. Server will accept both formats. For 10 days we'll synthesize compact hints when only legacy headers exist, tagging them `_synth_compact` in logs. After that we stop.
olivia: SDK request: convenience helpers to encode/decode compact hints, plus an opt-in flag. Example TS: `client.setCompactRoute({intent:'purchase', team:'billing'})`. Python similar. Go: functional option.
ryan: Can we keep the SDK helpers pure (no network calls) and add unit tests that roundtrip? Also add metrics `compact_route_encode_error`.
maya: Agreed. I'll open PRs: py#900 ts#301 go#410. Will add unit + integration tests in the harness.
nidhi: Console: backfill plan looks ok but we must mark synthesized rows and ensure quota attribution uses original legacy fields when present. Backfilling 30 days in prod after staging verify.
ops-bot: Canary deployed to us-west-2 (5%). Monitoring: minor spike in header decode warnings ~0.1%.
ryan: Add `compact_route_parse_fail` metric and a debug log for the first 500 failures to inspect payloads.
maya: Doing that now. Will delay prod backfill until decode_fail < 0.02% for 1 hour.
olivia: Timeline: Mon SDK PRs + docs; Tue staging backfill dry-run; Wed canary; Thu prod backfill if stable. Owners: maya -> SDKs, nidhi -> console/backfill, ryan -> tests/metrics. I'll post checklist.
